note: A warm-up (DayShape2): part 1 of the guitar warm-up run, picked by its kind and never for a path step. Hands and wrists loosened away from the neck, with the care line. missing: a tool or a video that shows hand stretches; the block is text only.

exercise.title: Loosen your hands and wrists
exercise.why: Moving your hands and wrists before you play brings blood into them, so the first stretch on the neck meets warm fingers and not stiff ones.

cells.text: Rest the guitar on your leg and take both hands off it.

items: Shake both hands out, loose from the wrist.
Make a soft fist, then open your hand wide. Do it a few times with each hand.
Circle each wrist slowly, one way and then the other.
With your picking hand, ease each finger of your fretting hand back a little, one finger at a time, then let it go.

cells.text:
Carry on until both hands feel warm and loose.
_Stop a stretch as soon as it hurts: it should feel easy, never sharp._
